name: BBU Launch 1 — Welcome to the New Platform
subject: Exciting News: Welcome to the New Birth & Baby University Platform!
html:
Exciting News: Welcome to the New Birth & Baby University Platform!

Hello Birth & Baby University Community,

We have some exciting news to share!

After years of using a white-label platform, Birth & Baby University now has its very own dedicated platform. This is a major milestone for our community, and we're excited about all the new possibilities it will bring.

Our new platform offers the same courses and learning experience you're familiar with, along with a more robust system that will allow us to continue growing and providing even more resources, programs, and opportunities for our families and birth professionals.

Right now, the platform is available as a website while we complete the process of registering our new app in the Apple App Store and Google Play. As soon as the mobile app is approved, we'll let you know so you can download it and enjoy an even better experience.

Your account has already been created for you.

Simply click your unique link below to activate your account and create your own password:

Once you've set your password, you'll have immediate access to your courses and community through the new platform. Our current platform will no longer be available after July 31st.

Thank you for your patience and flexibility during this transition. We're incredibly grateful to have you as part of the Birth & Baby University community, and we can't wait for you to experience everything our new platform has to offer.

Welcome to the future of Birth & Baby University!

With gratitude,

Anna Rodney and the Birth & Baby University Team
